intent: migrate_layout: enrich non-convergence report with blocking paths
notes: **Made the "mixed" migration outcome self-explanatory.** Prior end-of-run message when `--migrate-layout` fell short of v2: `"Result: mixed (migration incomplete — check conflicts)"` — with no signal of which paths were blocking convergence. Operators had to open a shell, grep the classifier internals, or file a bug just to find out what to delete. That was the exact confusion cycle behind Issue #6's manual-cleanup workaround.

**Fix**: added `_enumerate_mixed_residue(gator_dir)` in `gator-update.py` (both wheel and template mirror). Enumerates the three categories `_has_legacy_shipped_content` checks — shipped root files at root, fully-shipped directories at root holding real (non-scaffolding) content, shipped default files at root of mixed directories — and returns `(path, reason)` tuples with the reason distinguishing "duplicated in .includes/" from "should have moved to .includes/" per category. `migrate_layout()`'s mixed-result branch now prints this as a numbered blocking-paths list with a "Suggested next step" hint. Fallback #1: if enumeration is empty but the migration logged conflicts via `_merge_dir_files_only`, those are printed instead. Fallback #2 (belt-and-suspenders): if both are empty, print a "should be unreachable — the enumerator has drifted from `_has_legacy_shipped_content`" note. Empty enumerator + no conflicts + still-mixed classification means the sync obligation has been violated.

**Sync-obligation**: applied identically to `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-update.py` (wheel) and `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/scripts/gator-update.py` (fleet mirror). `git diff --no-index --stat` still shows the same 159-line pre-existing entry-point-inlining divergence; nothing new. The enumerator itself imports from `gator_layout` rather than duplicating the classification lists — one source of truth for `SHIPPED_ROOT_FILES` / `SHIPPED_DIRECTORIES` / `MIXED_DIRECTORY_SHIPPED_DEFAULTS` / `USER_VISIBLE_SCAFFOLDING`.

**Regression pins** (`tests/test_layout.py::TestMigration`): three new cases exercising the enumerator directly. `test_enumerate_mixed_residue_finds_root_file` covers Category 1 with both duplicated and missing-from-includes reasons. `test_enumerate_mixed_residue_ignores_scaffolding_only_dir` pins the intentional exemption for reference-notes/ that holds only `README.md` + `_template.md`. `test_enumerate_mixed_residue_reports_dir_with_real_content` covers Category 2's "could not be merged" reason when both root and .includes/ hold the same shipped dir. All 11 `TestMigration` cases pass.

**Charter updates**: `scripts-repo-lifecycle.md` — added `_enumerate_mixed_residue` entry with tripwire about the sync obligation with `_has_legacy_shipped_content`; extended `migrate_layout`'s tripwire list with the enriched-report behavior and the "should be unreachable" branch semantics.

Part of the "update and begin-session bugs" fix set (plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-03-update-and-begin-session-bugs-implementation-plan.md`, step A2 of B1→B2→A1→A4→A2→B3→A3). A1 fixed the automatic convergence for the common cases; A2 makes the residual cases self-diagnosable instead of opaque.
